text:
emma: Heads up — I'm drafting the release notes for v0.10.0 for the docs site. Primary items: Dedicated autoscaling config, API streaming changes for embeddings, and a short rollback guide for model routing. I'll push a first pass to the docs PR list (see PR #3421).

jon: Nice. For the SDK snippet, do we want to surface both REST and Python examples? Last time we only had JS and that confused some customers.

emma: Good call. I'll add Python + curl. Proposed Python snippet:

```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key="$REDWOOD_KEY")
resp = client.text.generate(model="kestrel-1", prompt="Summarize the design decisions.", stream=False)
print(resp.text)
```

emma: Note: the old snippet used `stream=True` by default — need to call out the streaming embeddings deprecation and link to the migration guide.

raj: Quick FYI — a couple links under the private deployment section 404 after the docs restructure. Example: `/docs/private/vpc-setup` should redirect to `/docs/private-deploy/vpc`. I can open a redirect PR (will target #3502).

sophia: I'll run the example test harness against the new snippets once PRs land. Please add explicit PR numbers in the changelog header so failing tests map back to the change.

emma: PRs to include: #3421 (release notes draft), #3490 (snippet updates), #3502 (redirects). Also a known-issue to call out: llama-large tokenization drift causing ~0.5s tail latency for >8k contexts — mitigation: pin quantized runtime 1.3.2.

noah: Add a canary rollout recommendation with fallback to kestrel-0.9 for heavy-traffic routes. A two-line instruction block would be ideal for ops folks.

emma: Agreed. Proposed wording for Known Issues section:

"Known issue: Llama-large may exhibit increased tail latency for sequences >8k tokens under certain quantized builds. Mitigation: pin inference runtime to 1.3.2 or enable autoscale burst. We expect a fix in 0.10.1."

jon: LGTM. One nit: change ‘pin’ -> ‘pin to’ and link runtime-pinning doc.

docs-bot: build status: docs-ci #3490 failed on snippet-check — pytest error in examples/test_snippets.py::test_python_generate

sophia: on it, will push a fix for the sample input that triggers a trailing-newline parsing bug in the snippet harness.

emma: Thanks all — final release note PR will land by 11:45 PT. If you want changes, please comment on #3421 before 11:00. :thumbsup:
